Also, be sure to WISHLIST BONE TOTEM - The new STASIS game coming next year!

now available in Polish!

Bulgarian, and both Simplified and Traditional Chinese, have also
recently been added to the localization offerings.

all the deluxe content/soundtrack is up at discount too!

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION is a 2D isometric adventure game set in the distant
future. Explore a post-apocalyptic landscape, solve puzzles, meet new
friends and make powerful enemies, mediate conflicts and fight for your
life as you unravel the secrets of the world around you in this homage
to adventure games from your childhood.

Be sure to WISHLIST our next game, STASIS 2: BONE TOTEM which is has a
2022 release date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/studio/discord

notes.title: STASIS 2 - BONE TOTEM is on Steam - wishlist and play the demo now
notes.content:
If you enjoyed CAYNE and want more isometric adventure, then check this out!


MORE AT: https://www.stasis2.com


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26766545/b142aa828ebbdf69e941c06fc165daee31fbdaae.png

Salvaging duo, Charlie and Mac scour the ocean for a living. They hit the motherload and come across DEEPSEA 15; a seemingly abandoned Cayne Corporation rig in the middle of the Pacific Ocean.

It only gets worse from there…

STASIS: BONE TOTEM is a thrilling and spine-tingling journey into the unknown fathoms of the icy ocean and the terrors that await a family. They will uncover a threat far beyond their wildest dreams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26766545/2c33c4949ff7c4a72f75032fb2244bf1319d3117.gif

Mac, Charlie, and their Super-Toy, Moses will scrape the depths of their resilience and descend into a sci-fi horror story that will test their resolve, their relationships and push them to the darkest corners of mankind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26766545/9275c2bfeab2bcf8ad49490d441eaa8a505d9a9f.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26766545/07d9218a473c5260fbed157cdf97afdb867dad0d.gif

By the team that created STASIS, CAYNE, and BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION, comes a gripping new tale set in the STASIS universe. STASIS: BONE TOTEM features beautifully created isometric environments and classic adventure gameplay, with a dash of horror.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26766545/0cae9c5122ee6885179e6d9c9e2ccd0ea559a97f.gif

You can play it now on Steam here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

PLEASE WISHLIST as well!

If you wan't to help with development and get your name in the final game, please visit us at https://www.stasis2.com

notes.title: Mick Gordon will be working on Beautiful Desolation and STASIS/CAYNE are on sale!
notes.content:
If you haven't checked out STASIS, now is a great time to do it! 

All versions are on sale!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/380150/STASIS/

CAYNE deluxe is also on sale

http://store.steampowered.com/app/532840/CAYNE/

Update on our next game, Beautiful Desolation

Great news! 

Award-winning composer, Mick Gordon, will use his broad experience to tell Beautiful Desolation’s auditory story. We’re thrilled to have such a talent translate our ideas into a sound unique to this game universe.

To many he needs no introduction, as Mick has score titles such as DOOM, Wolfenstein: The New Order and Microsoft’s Killer Instinct reboot under his belt (we said award-winning, right?!); so every note and precisely placed chord will draw you in.

His use of both traditional and modern techniques, and sometimes unconventional musical pairings, matches Desolation’s tribalpunk clash of old and new.

Collaborating with an experienced and passionate artist, who considers the role of the game’s music as a translation of its environment, allows for us to the convey ideas, emotions and backstory for each track.

This way Mick fully appreciates and applies this from the outset to create his own musical vision.

You can find out about Mick here: http://www.mick-gordon.com/

A few new screenshots

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/4cd445f8d20ec0cd1119c615afe2723eeef347d5.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/33862311124fa86cfe7709a7eede4943463e5d2a.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/eee023f2371b393dc7eb0b32e175ccb3f6bd811d.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/12767aebadb2ada58b341a63fe520f0d7dd9a0c4.jpg

You can also watch a video presentation here:

https://youtu.be/-Cwbo2BUXUc

Sign up on our site to get a notification when we launch on Steam:

http://www.desolationgame.com

Take care,

-Chris

notes.title: CAYNE IS FREE AND DESOLATION IS LIVE
notes.content:
DID SOMEBODY SAY FREE?

CAYNE is a free, point-and-click, isometric adventure game, following STASIS and features a new graphics engine.

In this grim return to the STASIS universe, expectant protagonist, Hadley, wakes up in a facility. Where is she? Why is she there? And, why do they want her baby? Help panicked and anxious Hadley find her feet and brave stomach-churning situations to break free, by solving puzzles in this FREE horror adventure game. Each step will uncover colorful character stories as you help Hadley find her way out.


 You can download CAYNE absolutely FREE on STEAM now! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/532840/

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/d9a63c213aee1c613a0ccea2a0084f2411057aac.jpg

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=znybWawsJ_4

 We hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it. 


We have also launched BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION on KICKSTARTER.

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION is an isometric post-apocalyptic adventure game. 

A tragic incident tears apart a brotherly bond but is also the catalyst for an epic adventure that spans from the 1980s and beyond.

LINK:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bischoff/beautiful-desolation-isometric-post-apocalyptic-ad

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Njw-brw_35A

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/6e4faf2d6f93a74167a3a65edaaa5ff68ee3a013.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/936cbd33903245f6658eef9131f45801e4c7cd02.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/9bac22e65873391363d6e5d3ce2dc8d50dcb4b67.jpg
